what_happened.line: The Planning Board voted 3-0 to approve the 1325 Massachusetts Avenue project with conditions, after closing the public hearing.
The board set construction hours for 1325 Mass Ave at weekday and Saturday windows stated in the decision.
The board voted 3-0 by roll call to approve and sign the Holman Street stormwater tri-party agreements.
The board interviewed three master plan consultant teams and said it would choose one within about 30 days.
A resident presented solar bylaw concerns; the board said review may come late March or early April, with no firm agenda date.

why_it_matters: The Holman Street agreements rest on bonds the town holds to pay for stormwater work, and a member doubted the amount held per lot would cover it, so residents there may see further board action.
The master plan consultant the board picks will shape planning for the whole town, and the solar bylaw review could bring a zoning change to a Town Meeting vote.
watch_next: The master plan consultant selection, expected within about 30 days of this meeting.
A future agenda item on closing the permit oversight gap behind the Holman Street problem, and the solar bylaw review, which has no firm date.
